name: Install Prettier
description: Add consistent code formatting with Prettier and a CI check workflow.

variables.commit_message: Add Prettier configuration and format-check workflow
variables.pr_body:
## Prettier Setup

This PR adds [Prettier](https://prettier.io/) for consistent code formatting.

### What's included

- **`.prettierrc.json`** — Prettier configuration with sensible defaults
- **`.github/workflows/format-check.yml`** — CI workflow that checks formatting on every push and PR

### Next steps

1. **Merge this PR**
2. Run `npx prettier --write .` to format existing files
3. CI will enforce formatting on future PRs

---

*Installed with [Kerex](https://kerex.app)*

params.content:
name: Format Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npx prettier --check .

outputs.value: A pull request has been created with the Prettier config and CI workflow.
